title: The Chosen One!!
reviewNotes: Captions and native complete diagrams reviewed. Native47 confirms the complete eight-piece final board White Kf4/a3/b3/d5/f3 against Kc8/a7/c5, White to move. The new independently supplied d6/Kd7/Ke5/Kc6/f4/Kb6/f5/Kc6/f6/Kd7/f7/Kc6/d7/Kxd7/f8=Q comparison demonstrates a conditional coordinated-passer finish. It is not a recovered source score or proof that Black must choose these moves. After Kxd7 an actual capture leaves seven pieces, White Ke5/a3/b3/f7 against Kd7/a7/c5; the separate conditional-leaf draft checks that position and f8=Q exactly. Black Ke7 would be ILLEGAL while White d6 remains, because that pawn attacks e7; the comparison uses Kc6 instead. Root and all preceding eight-piece outcomes remain unproved. Verify every omitted Black king/pawn defense, full eight-piece conversion and earlier queen-confinement claims before a verified label. Previous drafts, probes, source images/captions and review history remain preserved.
